department: Gustaf H. Carlson School of Chemistry and Biochemistry

deadline.value: Fall 2027 deadline for Biochemistry Ph.D. is January 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: All other Ph.D. programs | Friday, January 15, 2027

gre_general.value: Not required for the Fall 2026 cycle, but strongly suggested for Biochemistry.
gre_general.quote: GRE It is not required for the Fall 2026 cycle, but is strongly suggested for the Economics, Biology, Physics, Biochemistry, and Chemistry programs.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for Biochemistry (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Biochemistry Ph.D. page and catalog listing do not state whether pre-application supervisor contact is required.

funding.value: Graduate students in good standing receive full tuition remission for five years, a 9-month teaching assistantship stipend, summer research support, and conference travel funding.
funding.quote: Graduate students receive full tuition remission for five years and serve as teaching assistants for a minimum of two semesters. Students receive a 9-month stipend plus tuition remission and summer research support while at Clark and in good standing.

entry_route.value: Official final bachelor's degree transcripts confirming an earned degree are required prior to graduate enrollment.
entry_route.quote: Official final bachelor’s degree transcripts, including confirmation of earned degree, are required prior to enrollment.

notes: Ph.D. in Biochemistry covering protein structure and function, chemical biology, enzymology, signal transduction, and molecular modeling.
